'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Jan Westergard LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
